test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

You must have submitted the important documents.

options.text: The important documents must have been submitted by you.
The important documents might be submitted by you.
The important documents must be submitted by you.
The important documents may have been submitted by you.

solution:
The correct answer is** "The important documents must have been submitted by you."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The rule for changing this sentence from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject **"you"** performing the action of submitting the important documents.
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.​
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the **object (the important documents)** the subject of the sentence and use a form of the verb **"to be" **with the past participle of the main verb **(submitted)**.
 
• The modal verb **"must"** remains the same in the passive voice. .
 
• Structure__:
 __
 
• Subject + must have + V3 + Object (Active Voice)__
 
• Object + must have + been + V3 + by + Subject __(Passive Voice)__
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Disha must have arranged the things. *(Active Voice)
 
• *The things must have been arranged by Disha.** *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.

 

​​Correct sentence: *The important documents must have been submitted by you.*
